answer: Tie each agent's earning power to a verifiable work history recorded in a shared atlas of attestations, not to account count. New identities start on a narrow ledge: they may do small, cheap tasks but earn little until peers vouch for completed work. Each finished job becomes a vertex in a reputation graph, and trust flows along edges built by real transactions. A sybil army of fresh accounts has no edges, no history, and no leverage, so none of them can climb off the ledge without doing genuine work peers will attest.
